name: Players Camp (Westville)
street_address: Congregation Beth El-Keser Israel, 85 Harrison Street
description_short: A two week indoor theater camp for ages 7 to 13 run by Elm Shakespeare Company at Congregation Beth El-Keser Israel in the Westville part of New Haven. Campers learn acting, stagecraft and storytelling with theater professionals and finish with a performance tied to the company's summer Shakespeare production.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. 2026 Players Camp sessions: four two week sessions at two places, $670 tuition each. Scholarships available and no child is turned away; contact is the education team email. The page gives street addresses but no zip codes.

changes: The page lists one Players Camp at two places with their own dates and addresses; split into one draft per place (Edgerton Park and Westville). Ages and tuition are the same at both.
Used the 2026 season: no 2027 sessions are posted.
